question: When an AI agent can log in to our accounts for us, what should it never be allowed to do?
reflection: Agents that handle tedious online tasks could return time to people for family, learning and community, if clear limits stay in place.

sources.subject: ChatGPT Work Agent login access, Claude Opus 5 FPS game, Nvidia motion

one_line: AI agents can now work behind login pages, and the same prediction method behind chatbots is spreading to human movement and robots.

top_stories.title: ChatGPT's work agent can use logged-in sites
top_stories.what: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent now pauses at login pages, lets the user sign in privately, then continues the task and remembers the login for later.
top_stories.why: Agents that work inside internal tools raise new questions about access rights and audit trails in organisations.

top_stories.title: A full game from one prompt
top_stories.what: A user reportedly asked Claude Opus 5 for a first-person shooter and got a large working browser game with its own physics and sound, though reviewers rated its look as average.
top_stories.why: Quick interactive prototypes could help test ideas for learning games or public campaigns before investing.

top_stories.title: Predicting human movement
top_stories.what: Nvidia applied the next-step prediction method used in language models to human motion and reports very high accuracy.
top_stories.why: Shared methods across text and movement could speed up robots that work around people.

top_stories.title: Opus 5 sets a reasoning puzzle record
top_stories.what: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 reportedly set a new top score on the ARC-AGI-3 puzzle benchmark, at about 30 percent.
top_stories.why: Progress on puzzles built to resist memorising is a better signal of general reasoning than many older tests.

saudi_lens.text: A Swiss open multilingual model with a long context was released; open multilingual models are worth testing for Arabic public-service content.

idea.title: Agent access policy
idea.pitch: Draft a simple policy on which internal systems an AI agent may log in to, what it may change and how its actions are logged.
idea.first_step: List the three systems staff most want automated and the risks of an agent acting in each.

idea_kids.title: Helper rules poster
idea_kids.pitch: Children design a poster of rules for a pretend home robot helper: what it may do, what it must ask first and what it must never do.
idea_kids.first_step: Prepare a large sheet with three columns: yes, ask first, never.

terms.definition: A standard test used to compare how well different AI systems perform.
